long.title: India's 74% dot balls
long.description:
New Zealand 333. India 89 all out. A 244-run defeat at Mount Maunganui. We took every ball of the 4th ODI (line, length, shot played, and whether the batter was in control) to work out who decided it and why: Matt Henry's triple-wicket first over, Will Young's 125 and the two lives that started it, and the middle overs where India lost the grip.

Sources: ball-by-ball data from ESPNcricinfo and Cricbuzz match pages (captured with our own tool, cross-checked over by over); result and Player of the Match from both. All numbers are computed by us from the ball data; 'not in control' is the Cricinfo shot-control flag. All graphics are original, not broadcast footage.

short.vo: India scored off just one ball in four.
India hit ten boundaries all innings. New Zealand hit forty-one.
Twenty-nine fours and twelve sixes. One hundred and eighty-eight runs in boundaries.
Seven of India's ten wickets fell to a defensive shot. Follow for the full breakdown.
